name: airport
description: ATTACH any Arrow Flight server as a full DuckDB catalog — schemas, tables, joins, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, all in standard SQL. Build a Flight server in Python, Go, or Rust and DuckDB queries it like a local database. Streaming Arrow over gRPC, no impedance mismatch.

cta.title: Mount Any Arrow Flight Server as a DuckDB Catalog
cta.description: Install Airport, write a Flight server in your language of choice, then ATTACH it from DuckDB. Schema discovery, query pushdown, and DML — all transparent.
